title: See Niagara Falls framed by winter ice

location.label: Niagara Falls State Park, New York

description: Watch the immense falls amid ice, snow and winter mist, using selected overlooks and the heated Scenic Trolley to make the visit manageable.
teaser: Watch the immense falls amid ice, snow and winter mist, using selected overlooks and the heated Scenic Trolley to make the visit manageable.
goodToKnow: The falls do not freeze solid. Check the trolley schedule, weather and icy footing on the day you visit.
